questions.question: Define the difference between absolute poverty and relative poverty. (4 marks)
Explain two causes of income inequality within a country. (6 marks)
Assess the usefulness of the Gini coefficient as a measure of income inequality. (10 marks)
Evaluate the view that globalisation has increased inequality between developed and developing countries. (20 marks)
Outline two economic effects of poverty on a developing country. (4 marks)
In a country, median income is $8.00 a day. The relative poverty line is set at 60% of median income. Calculate the relative poverty line. (2 marks)
Explain how an increase in welfare benefits paid to the poorest households could reduce relative poverty. (4 marks)
Evaluate the view that economic growth is the most effective way to reduce absolute poverty in developing economies. (20 marks)
Analyse how structural changes in an economy may increase absolute poverty. (6 marks)

On a Lorenz curve diagram for a country, the area below the Lorenz curve is 0.32. Ten years later it has fallen to 0.27. Calculate the Gini coefficient in each year and the change between them. (4 marks)
Examine two causes of inequality in income between countries. (8 marks)
Discuss the likely impact of high income inequality on enterprise and savings in an economy. (14 marks)
Evaluate the view that a free market economy inevitably increases inequality. (20 marks)
Evaluate the extent to which economic development reduces inequality within a country. (20 marks)
